resources.string: Gemini AI (any language, needs an API key)
Offline OCR (English only, free, no key needed)

OCR reads English only. The first use needs an internet connection to download the translation model (about 30 MB); after that it works fully offline. OCR does not distinguish Simplified and Traditional Chinese — Chinese output is always Simplified.
Gemini API key (use your own — get one free at aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)
Image detail (low uses the least quota)
Tap the blue frame to translate again (that tap will not reach the game; if turned off, use “Retranslate” from the long-press menu)

While one of these apps is in front, the leaf dot will not capture or translate anything. This needs “Usage access” so the app can tell which app is on screen. Most banking apps already block screenshots, and this list is a second layer. The name check is only a guess and cannot cover every bank in the world, so add your own apps below.
